description: Change a contact's fields. A field you send replaces what is there, blank included. A custom field sent as null or blank is removed. A new address clears the old address's verdict, and its checks that haven't started are canceled. The new address takes a check already under way at it, or a fresh verdict another check reached, or it gets a new check when you hold the validate permission and address checks are turned on (get_email_check_setup). The same address in other letter case keeps its verdict. The address is checked first: a refused one answers 400 with `params.issue` naming why (missing_at, display_name, domain_invalid…).

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.
